Package it.polimi.ingsw.client.tui

Class TUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.tui.TUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
UIManager
public class TUI extends Object implements UIManager
This class is the Text User Interface of the client side of the application. It allows the user to interact with the game through the terminal.
